stable.release_notes: AgentNEO v3.0.13 expands Media Studio ComfyUI integration with an all-assets ComfyUI selector, dedicated Diffusion model / VAE / Text encoder menus, automatic loader-aware model discovery, normal ComfyUI saved/preset workflow conversion, native subgraph handling, and automatic workflow assignment from ComfyUI workflow-template and user-workflow APIs while retaining the scroll-safe layout and long-running job monitor.
